name: Aitsu to Share House
original_name: あいつとシェアハウス
source:
A boy's drama love with two childhood sweethearts, a catboy, a dogboy and everyone around them. "Let's rent a house together!" ——Starting with this sentence, the catboy "Akashi Yoshito", who was shaken by the words of the dogboy "Daichi Akagi", his childhood friend and best friend, began a heart-pounding college life cohabitating reluctantly with his crush.

[Edited from [url=https://kemono.games/game/Shared-House]Kemono Games[/url]]

Based on the [url=https://www.pixiv.net/novel/series/697988]original Japanese novel[/url] of  [url=/s34444]Hinaga[/url].
translation:
一个男孩与两个青梅竹马、一个猫男孩、一个狗男孩以及他们周围的人的戏剧爱情。“我们一起租房子吧！” ——从这句话开始，被青梅竹马、闺蜜狗仔“赤木大地”的话语所震撼的猫少年“明石义人”，开始了与暗恋对象恋恋不舍同居的令人心潮澎湃的大学生活。

[编辑自[url=https://kemono.games/game/Shared-House]兽游戏[/url]]

基于[url=https://www.pixiv.net/novel/series/697988]日本原著小说[/url]的[url=/s34444]日永[/url]。
